property_evidence.title: Overview and Methodology, ecoinvent data v2.0 (2007)
property_evidence.interpretation: Published generic natural-gas NCV45.4MJ/kg, applied as explicit fuel-quality proxy; source-specific NCV remains unknown.

selected_disposition.limitations: User-approved autonomous modelling decision: legacy source-mass-based delivered-gas ENERGY SCREENING PROXY, not a verified source calorific property. The exact3.6cut-off Europe-without-Switzerland market group has positive1m3 reference, declared dry/wet fuel mass0.842655842955148kg and zero water, but no net calorific property; its gross-energy field10.9015926281975MJ is not substituted for net energy. Ecoinvent v2 Overview and Methodology(2007), Table4.6, provides a generic natural-gas net calorific value45.4MJ/kg. Apply that documented legacy FUEL-QUALITY ASSUMPTION to the audited source mass: 38.256575270163715MJ per original m3, supplied by the complete native RER high-pressure gas-at-consumer process. This is a calibrated functional fuel-supply proxy, not a measured3.6NCV or exact gas-composition/volume/carbon-mass equivalence. It avoids assuming equal m3/Nm3 states and does not inherit the independently documented3.9Swiss36MJ/m3. The native RER model represents EU-28 trade2023 with production, transport, distribution, compression, network own fuel and leakage; source geography/origin mix, historical fuel quality, density/carbon content, trade vintage, internal uncertainty and2991upstreambiosphere exclusions differ. Caller volume, signed uncertainty and formulas remain unchanged at factor+1, as do separately listed stack emissions. No extra burner, network, dilution/state correction, avoided credit or numerical calorific uncertainty distribution is invented; proxy score effects remain unquantified. Only the exact3.6cut-off identity/profile is qualified; no other release, reverse or cross-system-model route inherits this property assumption.
